-------Source--------
select * from d360.STG_RLS_RefRowLevelSecurity order by 1,2,3,4,5

-------Target--------
select * from dw.RefRowLevelSecurity
select * from dw.RefRowLevelSecurityAudit
select * from dw.RefRowLevelSecurityFilter
select * from dw.RefRowLevelSecurityFilterAudit

alter table dw.RefRowLevelSecurity
alter column DataLayer varchar(120) NULL


/*****************RefRowLevelSecurity*******************/
-----------------tc1------------------------

SELECT TABLE_NAME, 
COLUMN_NAME, 
CASE WHEN DATA_TYPE = 'nvarchar' THEN DATA_TYPE + '(' + CAST(CHARACTER_MAXIMUM_LENGTH AS varchar(10)) + ')' 
	 WHEN DATA_TYPE = 'varchar' THEN DATA_TYPE + '(' + CAST(CHARACTER_MAXIMUM_LENGTH AS varchar(10)) + ')' 
	 WHEN DATA_TYPE = 'char' THEN DATA_TYPE + '(' + CAST(CHARACTER_MAXIMUM_LENGTH AS varchar(10)) + ')' 
	 WHEN DATA_TYPE = 'numeric' THEN DATA_TYPE + '(' + CAST(NUMERIC_PRECISION AS varchar(10)) + ',' + CAST(NUMERIC_SCALE AS varchar(10)) + ')' 
	 WHEN DATA_TYPE = 'decimal' THEN DATA_TYPE + '(' + CAST(NUMERIC_PRECISION AS varchar(10)) + ',' + CAST(NUMERIC_SCALE AS varchar(10)) + ')' 
	 WHEN DATA_TYPE IN ('datetime','datetime2', 'date', 'int', 'bigint', 'tinyint', 'float', 'smallint','bit','time') THEN DATA_TYPE
	 WHEN DATA_TYPE = 'bit' THEN DATA_TYPE + '(' + CAST(NUMERIC_PRECISION AS varchar(10)) + ',' + CAST(NUMERIC_SCALE AS varchar(10)) + ')'
	 END AS DATA_TYPE,
	 LEFT(IS_NULLABLE,1) IS_NULLABLE			 
FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS 
WHERE TABLE_NAME IN ('RefRowLevelSecurity') and TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dw'
ORDER BY 1

------------------tc2-----------------------


select 'Source' Tables, count(1) CNT from d360.STG_RLS_RefRowLevelSecurity where h = 'd'
UNION ALL
select 'Target' Tables, count(1) CNT FROM dw.RefRowLevelSecurity


------------------tc3-----------------------



select count(1) null_cnt from dw.RefRowLevelSecurity
where
UserID is null or
UserName is null or
UserGroup is null or
UserEmail is null or
BankID is null or
SourceSystemCode is null 


-------------------tc4-------------------------


with src_cnt as(
select * from  d360.STG_RLS_RefRowLevelSecurity a where h = 'D' and not exists  
(select * from dw.RefRowLevelSecurity b 
where a.UserID = b.UserID
and a.UserName = b.UserName
and a.UserGroup = b.UserGroup
and a.UserEmail = b.UserEmail
and a.BankID = b.BankID
and a.SourceSystemCode = b.SourceSystemCode
and a.[Data Layer] = b.DataLayer
)
)
, tgt_cnt as
(
select * from dw.RefRowLevelSecurity b where not exists  
(select * from d360.STG_RLS_RefRowLevelSecurity a
where h = 'D' 
and a.UserID = b.UserID
and a.UserName = b.UserName
and a.UserGroup = b.UserGroup
and a.UserEmail = b.UserEmail
and a.BankID = b.BankID
and a.SourceSystemCode = b.SourceSystemCode
and a.[Data Layer] = b.DataLayer
)
)
select 'Source' as tables, count(1) cnt from src_cnt
UNION ALL
select 'Target' as tables, count(1) cnt from tgt_cnt

-------------------tc5------------------------
select count(1) dup_cnt  from (
select UserID, UserName, UserGroup, UserEmail, BankID, SourceSystemCode, DataLayer
, count(1) cnt from dw.RefRowLevelSecurity
group by  UserID, UserName, UserGroup, UserEmail, BankID, SourceSystemCode, DataLayer
having count(1)>1 ) a

with src_cnt as(
select * from  dw.RefRowLevelSecurity a where not exists  
(select * from dw.RefRowLevelSecurityAudit b 
where validEndDttm = '9999-12-31'
and a.UserID = b.UserID
and a.UserName = b.UserName

and a.BankID = b.BankID

)
